faq.title: Questions Before You Start
faq.description: Clear answers about setup, cost, image quality, privacy, and supported devices.

howItWorks.question: How does it work?
howItWorks.answer: Choose a Preset or Mask, or describe your idea in Studio. Add a photo when prompted, check the credit cost, and create.

sourcePhotos.question: Is personal AI model training required?
sourcePhotos.answer: No. Use presets, Masks, and Studio with a photo or reference without training a personal model. For repeated photos of the same person, you can optionally train a model with 10–20 varied selfies. Training uses credits and does not require a subscription.

pricing.question: How much does it cost, and are there limits?
pricing.answer: Weekly and yearly subscriptions include 40 credits each week. Or buy a one-time credit pack. The app shows the credit cost before you create. Final prices and available offers appear in the app or store.

subscriptions.question: How do I manage or cancel a subscription?
subscriptions.answer: Manage or cancel your subscription through your account in the app, Apple Account, or Google Play, depending on where you bought it. For web purchases, use subscription management in the app or contact support. Canceling stops future renewals. Your purchased credits and trained personal AI models remain available; weekly credits keep their expiry dates.

imageQuality.question: What affects image quality?
imageQuality.answer: Your source photo, chosen look, and prompt all affect the result. Use a clear, well-lit photo and describe what you want to change or preserve.

privacy.question: How are my photos and data handled?
privacy.answer: You choose whether generated photos are public or private. Photos stay in your account until you delete them, and you can permanently remove individual images or your full library. We do not sell your personal data.

platforms.question: Where can I use My AI Photoshoot?
platforms.answer: Use it in a web browser or through the iOS and Android apps.

whyNotChatGPT.question: How is this different from a general AI image tool?
whyNotChatGPT.answer: My AI Photoshoot brings Presets, Masks, and Studio together so you can try new looks, edit photos, and create portraits in one place.

creditExpiry.question: Do my credits expire?
creditExpiry.answer: Subscription credits refresh each week. Unused weekly credits expire at the end of their grant period and don’t roll over. Credits bought in one-time packs never expire, so you can use them whenever you like.

writing.question: Do I need to write a perfect prompt?
writing.answer: No. Describe what you want in your own words. Auto Mode interprets your request and refines the prompt before generation.

autoMode.question: What does Auto Mode do?
autoMode.answer: It refines your prompt and handles generation automatically. When you use a photo, it also analyzes the image.

personal.question: Can I use Studio with a personal AI model?
personal.answer: Yes. Choose an existing personal AI model, then describe the new photo you want. Photos made with a personal model have their own workflow and credit price.

required.question: Do I need to train a personal AI model?
required.answer: No. You can use Studio with a photo. Train a personal model only when you want to create multiple photos of the same person.

credits.question: Where can I see the credit cost?
credits.answer: Studio shows the current credit cost beside the create button. Training a personal AI model is charged separately.
